title: 月亮变胖又变瘦
subtitle: 月亮每天都在换样子
character: wearing a navy blue pajama top, navy trousers and grey slippers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration in scratchboard style: the whole picture is a flat solid black surface with bright lines and shapes scratched out of it in glowing white, pale yellow and soft blue, everything drawn with simple scratched strokes and hatching, flat and graphic, not a photograph and not a realistic rendering

pages.zh:
晚上，我和爸爸在院子里乘凉。
天黑下来，星星一颗一颗亮起来。
爸爸指着天上说：
「你看，今天的月亮多圆。」
pages.scene: Night in a backyard: the little boy in pyjamas stands on the grass with his father, a tall grown adult man with short black hair in a grey shirt, beside him, both looking up at a big round full moon in a starry sky.

pages.zh:
今晚的月亮圆圆的，
亮亮的，挂在树梢上。
上面还有一块一块淡淡的影子，
像被谁轻轻擦过。
pages.scene: A big round full moon filling most of the picture, with faint darker patches on its surface, a few thin tree branches crossing in front of it, stars around.

pages.zh:
过了几天，我又去看月亮。
咦？它少了一小块。
右边圆圆的，
左边却像被咬掉了一口。
pages.scene: A gibbous moon in the night sky with one side round and the other side flattened and dark, a few stars around it.

pages.zh:
我把每天晚上看到的月亮，
都画在一个小本子上。
一页画一个。
画着画着，我发现——
它每天都不一样。
pages.scene: The little boy sits at a desk by a window at night with a small notebook open, drawing a moon shape with a pencil, several pages of different moon shapes pinned on the wall beside him.

pages.zh:
爸爸说，月亮自己不会发光。
它是一个又大又冷的石头球，
表面坑坑洼洼的，
没有一点自己的光。
pages.scene: A large grey rocky ball with craters floating alone on a black background, no light of its own, a few distant stars.

pages.zh:
我们看到的月光，
其实是太阳的光。
太阳照在月亮上，
月亮把光反射回来，
我们就看见它亮了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain on a solid black background: a round yellow sun at the far left and a round grey moon at the far right, three straight bright rays going from the sun to the moon, the left half of the moon facing the sun glowing pale yellow and its right half dark grey. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
月亮一边自己转，
一边绕着地球转圈。
转一圈大约要一个月。
它离我们很远很远，
可是一直跟着地球走。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain on a solid black background: a blue-green earth ball in the middle, a thin white dotted circle drawn around it, one small grey moon sitting on that circle at the right, and one curved white arrow on the circle showing the moon travelling anticlockwise. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
太阳只能照亮月亮的一半。
被照到的那一半是亮的，
照不到的那一半是暗的。
我们看到多少亮的部分，
月亮就是什么样子。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain on a solid black background: one large moon ball seen from the side in the middle, its left half brightly lit pale yellow and its right half dark grey, with three straight bright rays arriving from a small yellow sun at the left edge. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
月亮转到太阳这一边的时候，
亮的那一半背着我们，
我们就几乎看不见它。
这时候的月亮，
叫做新月。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain on a solid black background: a small yellow sun at the left, a grey moon ball in the middle with its lit half facing the sun and its dark half facing right, and a blue-green earth ball at the right, all three in one straight horizontal line, so from the earth only the dark side of the moon can be seen. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
又过两三天，
天边出现一条细细的月牙，
弯弯的，像一只小船。
它出现在太阳落下的方向。
pages.scene: A thin crescent moon low in the dark sky just above the horizon line, with the last glow of sunset at the horizon and a few stars above.

pages.zh:
月牙一天比一天胖。
先是细细的一条，
然后变成半个圆——
这是上弦月，
晚上早早就能看见。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain on a solid black background: one moon shown large in the middle, exactly half of it lit bright white on the right side and the other half dark grey, the edge between them a straight vertical line. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
再过几天，
月亮几乎全亮了，
只剩一点点缺口。
最后终于变成一个大圆盘：
满月。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain on a solid black background: two moons side by side, the left one almost fully lit with a thin dark sliver on its left edge, the right one a completely round fully lit white circle. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
满月之后，
月亮又开始一点点变瘦。
先缺一小块，
再变成半个圆，
最后又剩下一条细细的月牙。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain on a solid black background: three moons in a row from left to right, the first almost fully lit, the second exactly half lit on the left side, the third a thin crescent on the left side, each the same size and evenly spaced. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
从新月到满月，
再从满月回到新月，
大约要二十九天半。
月亮的这些样子，
有一个名字，叫做「月相」。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain on a solid black background: eight moons arranged evenly around one large circle, starting at the top with a completely dark moon and going clockwise through thin crescent, half lit, almost full, fully lit white, almost full again, half lit and thin crescent, each moon the same size. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以，看看月亮，
就能猜出今天是这个月的哪几天。
以前的人出海、种地，
都靠月亮数日子。
pages.scene: An old paper calendar page on a dark table lit by moonlight, with small moon shapes drawn in the corner of some of the day squares.

pages.zh:
中秋节那天，月亮最圆。
我们一家坐在院子里吃月饼。
妈妈说：
「今天的月亮，和你出生那天一样圆。」
pages.scene: Night in the backyard: the little boy sits at a small table with his mother, a grown adult woman with short black hair in a red sweater, and his father, a tall grown adult man with short black hair in a grey shirt,, a plate of round mooncakes on the table, a big full moon above them, warm lantern light.

pages.zh:
爸爸拿出一个小望远镜。
我凑上去一看——
月亮上真的有好多坑！
有大的，有小的，
一个挨着一个。
pages.scene: The little boy looks through a small telescope on a tripod in the backyard at night, one eye closed, his mouth open in surprise, the moon glowing above.

pages.zh:
该睡觉了。
我躺在床上，
月光从窗户照进来，
照在我的被子上。
明天的月亮，又会变一点点。
pages.scene: The little boy lies in bed under a blanket at night, moonlight coming through the window and falling across his blanket, a crescent moon visible outside the glass.
